# Integrating Driver Side Rocker Switch for Lightbar Control

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Pass the switch harness through the firewall grommet and install it on the driver side knee panel. [t167]

## Tools

- Rasp or reamer [t167]

## Tips & gotchas

- The 2010 Xterra has three covered openings on the driver side knee panel; use a rasp to open one for proper fitment. [t167]
- [Partial] Pull power from the passenger side fuse box (facing the door) via a wire pull if not using an external source. [t167]
